metas.name: Shallow Grave
metas.description: Three smug Edinburgh flatmates find their new lodger dead beside a suitcase of cash, and calmly decide to keep the money and lose the body. Danny Boyle's first film is pitch-black, funny and cruel, with a perfect last turn.

metas.name: The Man Who Wasn't There
metas.description: A taciturn barber's blackmail scheme leads to murder and he barely blinks. The Coens' deadpan noir in black and white.

metas.name: Bad Education
metas.description: A beloved school superintendent is quietly at the center of a massive embezzlement scandal. True-life fraud played with a straight face, and Hugh Jackman never drops the act.

metas.name: Killer Joe
metas.description: A broke family hires a cop who moonlights as a hitman, and offers their daughter as his retainer. A vicious Southern noir comedy with a notorious finale.

metas.name: Swimming with Sharks
metas.description: A Hollywood assistant takes his abusive studio boss hostage. A bitter satire that ends with a cold twist.

metas.name: American Psycho
metas.description: A Wall Street yuppie confesses his murders to people who can't tell him apart from anyone else. A satire of masks and conformity played completely straight.

metas.name: Calvary
metas.description: In confession, a priest is told he will be killed in a week for another man's sins. Bleak Irish gallows humor building to a reckoning.

metas.name: Riders of Justice
metas.description: A grieving soldier and a trio of statistics nerds calmly set out to avenge a train crash. A Danish revenge comedy, darker and stranger than it sounds.

metas.name: In Order of Disappearance
metas.description: A stoic snowplow driver works through a drug gang to avenge his son. Norwegian deadpan, with the body count kept like a ledger.

metas.name: The Banshees of Inisherin
metas.description: On a remote Irish island, one man abruptly ends a friendship and backs it up with a horrifying threat that he fully means. The comedy is bleak and deadpan, and the pettiness escalates into self-mutilation and arson.
